lead_story.headline: Texas Rangers 6, Houston Astros 5
paragraphs: The Texas Rangers defeated the Houston Astros 6–5 in walk-off fashion. Jacob Latz earned the win.

secondary_stories.headline: Boston Red Sox 3, New York Mets 2
paragraphs: The Boston Red Sox defeated the New York Mets 3–2 in extra innings. Aroldis Chapman earned the win. Garrett Whitlock recorded the save.

secondary_stories.headline: Philadelphia Phillies 5, Detroit Tigers 0
paragraphs: The Philadelphia Phillies defeated the Detroit Tigers 5–0. Zack Wheeler earned the win.
